professionalSummary: Project manager with four years of experience leading regulatory reporting change initiatives within a mid‑sized bank, managing six projects under the bank’s formal change framework.  Demonstrated expertise in planning, budgeting, steering committee reporting, dependency management with reporting platform and finance teams, and closure documentation with regulator deadline evidence.  Holds 35 contact hours of project management education and is in the process of obtaining PMP certification.  Prior experience includes two years as a project coordinator on a claims system replacement at an insurer.
experienceHighlights: • Managed six regulatory reporting change projects, each with a detailed plan, budget tracker, and monthly steering committee report.  All projects were completed within the change framework and received acceptance from the change framework office.
• Coordinated dependencies with the reporting platform team and finance, maintaining a dependency log and escalating two platform slips to the portfolio board.
• Authored project closure reports that included project boundary statements and regulator deadline evidence; all six reports were accepted by the change framework office.
• Completed 35 contact hours of project management education (2025) and scheduled PMP exam for November 2026; application accepted by the institute in July 2026.
• Served as project coordinator for a claims system replacement at an insurer for two years prior to joining the bank.
projectsAndWorkSamples: • Work sample: plan, budget tracker, and closure report for one regulatory project, including change framework office acceptance reference and institute application acceptance email (src_6c5f2f7cef1a).
